Compare the added retention bundle: success collection, own fixed teachers, support weighting and retention/routing. Not support-calibration alone; interactions differ.

Fixed-grid lambda sensitivity with the same algorithm and nominal budget, but different devices/recovery histories and own later caches. Not a q-calibration removal or lambda=0 ablation.
